Entries.Zh:
① 使用支持数据传输的USB线。
② 手机启用开发者选项 → USB调试。
③ 确认手机上的RSA授权弹窗。
④ 刷新，选择设备并信任。
⑤ 安装手机端；如品牌有USB安装开关，需手动允许。
⑥ 选非主屏VDD，开始扩展。

无需连接显卡接口，不启用无线ADB，不Root。
Entries.En:
1. Use a USB cable that supports data transfer.
2. Enable Developer options and USB debugging on Android.
3. Verify the computer and accept its RSA authorization prompt.
4. Refresh, select your device, then explicitly trust it.
5. Install the client; confirm any USB installation prompt on the device.
6. Select an existing non-primary VDD to extend your desktop.

Use a computer USB port, not a video connector. No wireless ADB or root.
(No device serial numbers or screen content copied.)

学习DeskMate的工作台布局思路，不复制其代码、图标或品牌；非上述项目的官方发行版。

Entries.En:

Original Windows interface and controller (MIT).
Video engine and Android client: AnyDisplay v0.1.4 (MIT).
Virtual display: Virtual Display Driver / MikeTheTech.

Workspace organization inspired by DeskMate; no DeskMate code, icons or branding included. Not an official distribution of those projects.
USB only; touch, audio and clipboard forwarding are disabled.

Entries.Zh: 在工作台选择并信任设备，再点击安装。安装包先校验 SHA-256，只操作你选择的设备；如需系统确认，请在手机上允许。

Entries.Zh: 打开 APK 所在目录
当前复用 AnyDisplay v0.1.4 Android 客户端（MIT），不是已经重写或改名的自有 APK。
Entries.En: Uses upstream AnyDisplay v0.1.4 for Android (MIT), not a rebuilt or rebranded hu1 display APK.

Entries.Zh: 真正扩展需要独立 VDD。已有 VDD 不要重复安装。新增驱动可能闪屏或重排窗口，需要管理员确认；不关闭签名校验，也不修改 NVIDIA 等显卡驱动。
Entries.En: Extend requires an existing VDD. Do not reinstall one that already works. Driver changes may blank screens or move windows and require administrator approval. Never disable signature checks or replace GPU drivers.

Entries.Zh: 手动向导：下一步 → 手动从列表安装 → 显示适配器 → 从磁盘安装 → C:\VirtualDisplayDriver\MttVDD.inf。只安装一次。
Entries.En: Manual wizard: Next → Install manually from a list → Display adapters → Have Disk → C:\VirtualDisplayDriver\MttVDD.inf. Install once only.

Entries.En: If supported, the virtual display will temporarily switch to the selected high refresh rate and restore at the end.

Entries.Zh: 显示布局已变化，请刷新后重试。
Entries.En: The display layout changed. Refresh and retry.

Entries.Zh: 虚拟屏未进入请求的刷新率。
Entries.En: The VDD did not reach the requested refresh rate.

Entries.Zh: 显示布局已被更改，未覆盖新设置。请核对虚拟屏刷新率。
Entries.En: The display layout changed. New settings were not overwritten; check the VDD refresh rate.

Entries.Zh: 虚拟屏刷新率还原未通过验证。
Entries.En: Could not verify the restored VDD refresh rate.

Entries.Zh: 虚拟屏刷新率切换失败，Windows 返回：
Entries.En: Windows rejected the VDD refresh change:

Entries.Zh: 每台已信任设备对应一块空闲虚拟屏。先选会话，再停止或调整小窗。
Entries.En: Pair each trusted device with a free VDD. Select a session to stop it or adjust its overlay.

Entries.Zh: 断开扩展连接时，将该屏窗口迁回实体主屏
Entries.En: Return windows to the physical primary display on disconnect

Entries.Zh: 不关闭应用，不改其他屏。部分系统、管理员或隐藏窗口可能无法迁回。
Entries.En: Apps stay open. Other screens are untouched. Elevated, system or hidden windows may be unavailable.
Window move requests: {0}; skipped or unavailable: {1}.
Device or display already in use.

Entries.Zh: 先结束所有虚拟屏会话，备份系统的 vdd_settings.xml。将 monitors 下的 count 改为需要的上限（例如 3），保留刷新率等其他配置，再按驱动说明重载该虚拟适配器。首次可在 Windows 显示设置中断开闲置虚拟屏。返回工作台刷新后，连接时会启用所选待机屏幕。不要重启实体显卡。
Entries.En: End all VDD sessions and back up the installed vdd_settings.xml. Under monitors, set count to the required capacity (e.g. 3). Preserve the other settings, then reload only the virtual adapter following its driver instructions. Initially disconnect idle virtual displays in Windows Display settings. Refresh the workspace; starting a route activates its standby display. Do not restart physical GPUs.

Entries.Zh: 断开时停用所选 MttVDD 桌面
Entries.En: Disconnect the selected MttVDD desktop when its session ends

Entries.Zh: 下次连接可重新启用。若虚拟屏还用于其他软件，请在连接前取消此项；按需启用的屏幕总是随会话释放。
Entries.En: Reconnect to activate it again. If another app needs an already-active VDD, clear this before connecting. A standby display activated by a session is always released.

Entries.Zh: 断开时将停用这块 Windows 虚拟桌面。
Entries.En: Disconnecting will remove this virtual display from the Windows desktop.
The selected virtual desktop is now disconnected.

Entries.Zh: 显示路径已变化或不唯一；请刷新或打开 Windows 显示设置。
Entries.En: Display path changed or is ambiguous; refresh or open Windows Display settings.

Entries.Zh: Windows 拒绝更改所选虚拟屏：
Entries.En: Windows rejected the selected virtual display change:

Entries.Zh: 没有空闲虚拟屏。可在「连接与安装 → 预留更多虚拟屏」查看扩容步骤。
Entries.En: No free VDD. See Setup → Prepare more display slots to increase capacity.

Entries.Zh: 计划同时使用的虚拟屏数
已生成配置副本，尚未应用到驱动。
Entries.En: Configuration copy exported; the installed driver has not been changed.

Entries.Zh: 配置格式不匹配或当前容量更大，未生成副本。
Entries.En: Unrecognized configuration or current capacity is larger; no copy exported.

Entries.Zh: 传输中仅可移动本次连接的虚拟屏。
Entries.En: During streaming, only move the virtual display owned by this session.

Entries.Zh: 显示布局正在切换，请稍后重试。
Entries.En: A display transition is in progress. Try again shortly.

Entries.Zh: 传输中可拖动已连接的虚拟屏；实体屏保持原位。
Entries.En: Drag the connected virtual display. Physical screens stay in place while streaming.

Entries.Zh: 只移动当前虚拟桌面，不重启视频引擎或更改分辨率。15 秒内未确认将还原。本次位置不写入系统配置。
Entries.En: Move this virtual desktop without restarting the engine or changing its resolution. Confirm within 15 seconds or the position is restored. This live position is not saved to system settings.
